ValidationRule.description: Created for SALDEV-1073. Used to keep Amendment/Renewal Quotes from being saved if there is no NS Sub Groups combined value on the original contract.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( ISBLANK(SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.SBQQ__AmendedContract__r.NS_Sub_Groups_Combined__c), ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Type__c, "Amendment"), ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Status__c, "Client_Approved")), AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.Type, "Auto Renewal")), ISBLANK( SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.SBQQ__RenewedContract__r.NS_Sub_Groups_Combined__c), ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Type__c, "Renewal"), ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Status__c, "Client_Approved")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Quote is missing a req System Field "NS Sub Groups", please submit a Jira ticket with this error to your Salesforce Admin to resolve.
